svg.title: real Perceiver cross-attention
svg.text: episode=place_phone_stand/episode_000042; camera=robotwin_head; frame=76; iteration=4; model step=2; n02-v12-p2-causal-r2

layer: readout_v12.N02ReadoutV12 encoder cross-attention (softmax over T tokens); head-averaged by the module, then mean over the 128 latent queries; divided by the frame maximum for display; state tokens take 0.000789 of the mass (128 latents x T tokens)
token -> sensor pixel mapping uses SpatialV12.coords of the same forward; unsampled cells take the nearest sampled cell (declared fill)
